quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 25 Questions • Passing Score 21

questions.question: What does a face shield do?

options.text: Does not protect as well as goggles.

questions.explanation: A plastic face shield protects your eyes and face best. Regular glasses or sunglasses do not work as well. In Vermont, you do not legally need eye or face protection if your motorcycle has a windshield, but it is still recommended.

questions.question: What is one benefit of regular motorcycle maintenance?

options.text: Your motorcycle will run well for a long time.
Maintenance checks take a lot of time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your motorcycle will run well for a long time.
questions.explanation: Regular maintenance keeps your motorcycle running like new. Schedule maintenance checks as part of your routine care.

questions.question: What is the main active ingredient in marijuana?
questions.explanation: THC (tetrahydrocannabinol) is the main active ingredient in marijuana.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride if you are tired. Take a rest break every two hours on long trips to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: How can you ride safer at night?

options.text: Other drivers cannot see your turn signals at night.
Only ride at night in the city.

questions.explanation: Wear reflective clothing at night so other drivers can see you.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, reduce your speed. Use both brakes and avoid sudden movements.

questions.question: Because alcohol does not need to be digested, what happens?

options.text: Alcohol reaches the brain within minutes and affects the drinker.
The alcohol stays in your body forever.
It takes a long time to feel drunk.
Your body removes alcohol very quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol reaches the brain within minutes and affects the drinker.
questions.explanation: Alcohol enters your bloodstream quickly and reaches your brain within minutes. Your body removes about one drink per hour.

questions.question: What do you need to carry a passenger safely?

options.text: Extra foot pegs for the passenger.
A seat built for two people.
Protective gear for both you and the passenger.

questions.explanation: To carry a passenger safely, you need a seat for two people, foot pegs for the passenger, and protective gear for both of you.

questions.question: Before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle, what should you do?

options.text: Ride it like your own bike, since all bikes are the same.
Learn where the controls are and how to shift.
Trust the owner that everything works.
Assume you know where the controls are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Learn where the controls are and how to shift.
questions.explanation: Every motorcycle is different. Before riding, practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes. Check the gear shift pattern.

questions.question: How can you help others see you on your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors, use your headlight at all times, and use your turn signals to be more visible to other drivers.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle rider improve their visibility?
questions.explanation: Wear bright-colored clothing with reflective materials so other drivers can see you. Always use your headlight. Use your signals and brake light properly.

questions.question: What does a plastic, shatter-resistant face shield do?

options.text: It is not needed if you have a windshield.
It does not protect as well as goggles.

questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your entire face in a crash. Goggles only protect your eyes. A windshield is not a good substitute for a face shield or goggles.

questions.question: Which of these do you NOT need to check before riding a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tire tread and air pressure, oil and fluid levels, and lights and signals.

questions.question: What type of sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Many surfaces reduce traction. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted markings, and metal covers are all hazardous. Dry pavement provides the best traction.

questions.question: What should your helmet do to give you the best protection?
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all the way around and have no obvious damage.

questions.question: The body eliminates about one drink per hour. If someone had eight drinks four hours ago, how many drinks are likely still in their system?
questions.explanation: Subtract the hours passed from the total drinks consumed. Eight drinks minus four hours equals four drinks remaining in the body.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after having one drink, can you ride safely?

options.text: Yes, you cannot be arrested for drinking and riding.
Yes, alcohol will not affect your skills.
No, alcohol effects may still remain.
Yes, as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, alcohol effects may still remain.
questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour on average. But alcohol can still build up in your system and affect your riding ability.

questions.question: What should you do if another driver is tailgating you?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to get them in front of you. If safe, change lanes and let them pass. Speeding up will only encourage them to tailgate faster.

questions.question: When braking, which brake should you use?

options.text: Either one, but never both at the same time.

questions.explanation: Always use both brakes at the same time to stop. The brakes work best when used together.

questions.question: Which surface is NOT slippery?

options.text: Oil stripe in the center of a lane

questions.explanation: Many surfaces reduce tire traction. Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, oil, and metal covers are all hazardous for motorcyclists. Dry pavement is the safest surface.

questions.question: A plastic face shield protects riders from:
questions.explanation: A face shield protects you from injury in a crash and from wind, dust, dirt, rain, insects, and pebbles kicked up by other vehicles.

questions.question: Downshifting to a lower gear is also called:
questions.explanation: Shifting to a lower gear creates an effect similar to braking. This is why downshifting is called engine braking.

questions.question: Which is NOT protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Protective gear includes sturdy pants and jackets that cover your arms and legs, boots or heavy shoes that cover and support your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: How can you make your motorcycle easier to see?

options.text: Attach a large flag to the frame

questions.explanation: Be easier to see by wearing bright, reflective clothing. Ride with your headlight on at all times and use your turn signals and brake light correctly.
